name: Sinopia
description: The editor of designs, slides, videos and sites. Built into the host: its page runs in the host's own page and talks to the host through the SDK in the same process.

backend.instructions: The sinopia_* tools read and change the Sinopia document the editor shows beside this chat, for the apps that work in it. While the person has the document open, page_tools (app harnessly.sinopia) says what the editor shows — the document, the board or slide on screen, the selection — and lists the editor's own tools (go to a slide, select, show a node); call them with page_call.
